title: Environment-dependent time, lapse, memory, and temporal resonance on fresh motion and photon-delay data
hypothesis: One universal weak-field temporal metric rule, selected without response access, predicts both baryonic galaxy motion and independently estimated strong-lens photon delays better than calibrated GR and ordinary target-blind nuisance models.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged temporal metric cell to improve fresh motion and photon-delay channels together, pass local clock/light and causality gates, survive broad slices, and later replicate across scales.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Retain any reproducible held-out clock, compactness, causal-settling, or temporal-resonance relation that beats ordinary controls on its actual domain even if it does not solve gravity universally.

theory.potential_closure: Phi_t=Phi_N+deltaPhi and Psi=Phi_N+s*deltaPhi, with H=r d(deltaPhi)/dr divided by r d(Phi_N)/dr represented by a frozen mechanism cell.
theory.motion_response: mu_D=1+H; nonrelativistic motion follows the temporal lapse potential Phi_t.
theory.photon_response: mu_T=1+(1+s)H/2; the same temporal and spatial potentials determine the leading Weyl/Shapiro contribution to photon delay.
theory.system_clocks: tau_dyn=sqrt(r^3/(G M_b)); t_age is the cosmic age at the system redshift, with local galaxies assigned z=0.
theory.solar_normalization: Each response is divided by its value at one AU in the Solar field so the laboratory Newton constant is the local normalization.
theory.causality: History cells use only a positive retarded exponential relaxation factor 1-exp[-t_age/(k tau_dyn)]; no future or negative-time support is admitted.

literature.label: Toniato and Rodrigues on PPN gamma-like parameters, slip, light deflection, and Shapiro delay
Jyoti et al. on strong-lens time delays as a gravitational-slip test
Asada on gravitational time delay in modified gravity
Millon et al. COSMOGRAIL XIX raw light-curve release

claim_limits: The four response families are weak-field action-adjacent closures, not exact solutions of a covariant fundamental theory.
A static gravitational slip does not by itself specify every time-delay observable; this experiment freezes one explicit metric closure and tests only its leading thin-lens implication.
The causal-settling niche uses cosmic age as an available history clock, not as a privileged or proven cause.
The temporal-resonance niche is a mathematical synthesis motivated by scale-dependent clocks; historical novelty is not claimed.

Positive lapse responses, causal kernels, local clock/light limits, and luminal photon propagation are enforced; radiation, cosmology, full Hamiltonian stability, and direct lens imaging remain later gates.

observable_lineage.motion_baryons: ALFALFA integrated HI mass plus extinction-corrected Legacy DR9 z-band light and Tractor half-light geometry, with a universal stellar mass-to-light calibration learned only inside training folds.
observable_lineage.motion_response: ALFALFA observed W50 is queried by AGC only after the roles and all 262,144 candidates are frozen; inclination is derived from target-blind Legacy axis ratio.
observable_lineage.photon_predictors: SQLS lens/source redshifts, image separation, image flux ratio, and lens-galaxy i magnitude are frozen static predictors.
observable_lineage.photon_response: The code estimates an A/B delay directly from the frozen exploration COSMOGRAIL raw light curve; no published delay table is queried or encoded.

sample.rule: Within four HI-mass strata select 40 target-blind Legacy-quality galaxies and seal eight per stratum; within two lens-redshift strata seal one of five safe SQLS/lcab lenses. Assign exploration identities to four balanced folds by HMAC before W50 or raw light curves are read.

candidate_generator.algorithm: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64) with four exactly balanced temporal mechanism niches before causal, positivity, and local filters

niches.behaviorally_equivalent_to: a bounded acceleration-running temporal potential, overlapping RAR/running-strength phenomenology

equivalence_boundaries: The screened static-lapse niche is a known behavioral control and is not novel merely because it is written as a lapse.
A compactness clock that becomes a one-variable acceleration response on the observed support is reported as an empirical rewrite, not a new theory.
Causal memory is non-equivalent only when its positive retarded age-to-dynamical-time factor varies on held-out support.
Temporal resonance is non-equivalent only when the frozen phase produces variation beyond an acceleration-only envelope.
Historical novelty is never inferred from algebraic non-equivalence; every surviving positive requires a separate literature audit.

evaluation.baseline_calibrated_GR: zero temporal response with one training-only offset per observable lane
evaluation.baseline_flexible_nuisance: fixed ridge regression on target-blind baryonic, geometric, redshift, and measurement-quality predictors separately in each lane
evaluation.baseline_separate_formula: the same frozen candidate library selected independently in motion and photon lanes, quantifying the cost of a universal shared cell
